scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:resolve: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma migrate resolve
scripts.db:push: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma db push
scripts.db:studio: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma studio
scripts.db:generate: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.start:backend:with-migrations: pnpm -C packages/database exec prisma migrate deploy && node apps/backend/dist/main.js
